The plate looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across (roughly 262 px in the image). The food is diced cooked chicken breast, piled in a pile about 150 px (roughly 11-12 cm) wide, with maybe 2-3 layers of pieces.

I estimate about 25-30 pieces at roughly 1.5-2 cm each. At about 4 g per cm³ for a 2 cm cube, each piece weighs 5-8 g, so the total is roughly 150 g, and I'll say 130 g to be conservative.

Cooked chicken breast runs about 165 kcal per 100 g. With a little seasoning or sauce, 130 g comes to about 215 kcal.
